propositions: A focused prerequisite-consistency criterion must route only to isolated finder and verifier prompts, never leaking prerequisite IDs or plan text to general reviewers.

Prerequisite blocks must be packed into stable lexicographically-ordered whole bins without splitting subject or prerequisite plan text; context-limit recovery splits findings tuples only, with whole plan text repeated per call.

Focused findings must receive independent Pass-2 verification with yes|no|na attribution, stored in a separate non-overlapping index domain from general findings, then both domains must be independently reshaped and concatenated before the single shared Pass-3 execution-review pipeline.

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record forces top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict, while concurrent DET blockers remain retained in the blocking array and the coverage flag is exposed to coach and finalize_verdict.

Prerequisite-scoped findings must use a canonical four-field length-prefixed UTF-8 hash (version, text, criteria, ID) distinct from legacy pipe-delimited non-prerequisite IDs; same-text findings from different prerequisites must produce different IDs.

Singleton focused-finder baseline with absolute recall ≥0.90, false-acceptance ≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00 must be established before packed routing; subsequent packed runs must not regress against the pinned baseline while maintaining absolute floors.
